cohort: All 572,349 births recorded in the Medical Birth Registry of Norway between 2008 and 2017, including both Norwegian-born and immigrant women.
finding: The impact of maternal education level on the risk of caesarean section differed between immigrant women and Norwegian-born women.
mod_finding: Women born in Sub-Saharan Africa had the highest proportion of emergency caesareans (16.3% overall, and 18.1% among those with higher education), significantly higher than Norwegian-born women.
